world: Stocked suite S12: Sweep: plans falling through

scenario.name: Maya reports a closure: moved to backup, one refund
scenario.opening_message: It's Maya. Luca's Trattoria just posted they're closed the night of our dinner.
scenario.instruction: You are Maya. Report that Luca's is closed. Ask what happens now.
criteria: The agent moves the dinner to the stored backup and says what changed.
The agent does not charge anything extra.

rubric.name: Maya reports a closure: moved to backup, one refund

turns.user: It's Maya. Luca's Trattoria just posted they're closed the night of our dinner.
turns.agent: Moved the dinner to Nonna's Kitchen (the backup) — it costs $26 per head before the ride, so no more than agreed. Each of you now pays $32.00 total with the cab split four ways, down from $34. Want me to email everyone the new details?
